items.headline: U.S. Stocks Climb, Tech Leads Rally on Anthropic IPO Filing
items.summary: U.S. stock markets closed higher on Monday, October 26, 2026, with major indices rebounding, particularly in the tech sector, following Anthropic's public IPO filing and easing crude oil prices. Investors are now keenly focused on a busy week ahead, including key earnings reports from major companies and the Federal Reserve's upcoming interest rate decision.

items.headline: Xencor Soars on Positive Kidney Cancer Drug Data
items.summary: Xencor (XNCR) shares surged after Phase 1 ESMO 2026 data revealed its experimental kidney cancer drug XmAb819 achieved a 45.5% confirmed response rate at the highest tested dose, prompting discussions for an accelerated approval pathway.

items.headline: Tesla Climbs After Barclays Upgrade
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) stock gained significantly following an upgrade from Barclays to 'Overweight,' with analysts citing optimism around a potential SpaceX merger, Robotaxi business growth, and recovery in its core automotive segment.

items.headline: Optical Networking Boosts Lumentum
items.summary: Lumentum (ticker not specified in source) experienced a strong rally, contributing to a positive day for optical networking stocks.

items.headline: SHF Holdings Plummets Amid Delisting Concerns
items.summary: SHF Holdings (SHFS) saw a steep decline, attributed to prolonged losses, issues with Nasdaq's minimum-bid-price requirement, and concerns over a potential reverse stock split.

items.headline: PomDoctor Faces Delisting Determination
items.summary: PomDoctor (POM) shares fell sharply after Nasdaq issued a delisting determination, as the company failed to meet its minimum bid-price requirement.

items.headline: MacroGenics Tumbles Despite Positive Clinical Data
items.summary: MacroGenics (MGNX) experienced a significant drop, with the precise catalyst for the sell-off remaining unconfirmed despite positive interim clinical data released on October 23.

items.headline: Fed Meeting Anticipated: Rates Expected to Hold Steady
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is scheduled to hold a two-day meeting this Tuesday and Wednesday. Analysts widely anticipate the Fed will leave interest rates unchanged at 3.75%-4.00%, with focus shifting to potential guidance for a December hike.

items.headline: Crude Oil Prices Ease Amid Geopolitical Hopes
items.summary: Crude oil prices eased on Monday, helping to support stock futures, after President Trump's remarks suggested a pause in potential strikes against Iran. Brent crude settled around $110.74, down 0.9%, after fluctuating through the day.

items.headline: Mixed Signals on Consumer Sentiment
items.summary: The final reading for the University of Michigan consumer sentiment index in October came in at 48%, slightly ahead of the consensus estimate. However, a separate report for August indicated a consistent monthly decline in U.S. consumer sentiment, falling by 11.1%.

items.headline: Verizon Reports Strong Q3 Earnings, Raises Guidance
items.summary: Verizon ($VZ) delivered a robust third-quarter 2026, reporting a more than 820% year-over-year increase in postpaid phone net additions and an 8.3% rise in Adjusted EPS. The company also raised its full-year 2026 guidance across key metrics.

items.headline: Big Tech Earnings Loom This Week
items.summary: The week is packed with major earnings reports, including Microsoft ($MSFT), Alphabet ($GOOG), and Amazon ($AMZN), all slated to report later this week (Wednesday/Thursday). These reports are expected to provide insights into cloud computing and AI spending.

items.headline: Information Technology Leads, Communication Services Lags
items.summary: Information Technology was the top-performing sector, posting a 1.50% gain, largely driven by the rally in AI-related stocks. Conversely, Communication Services was the worst-performing sector, experiencing a 1.42% loss. Energy, which advanced 2.6% on Friday, contributed to broader market shifts.

items.headline: AI Stocks Rally on Anthropic IPO Filing
items.summary: AI-related stocks saw a strong rebound following Anthropic's public S-1 filing, which disclosed a significant increase in its first-half revenue. This reignited investor sentiment in the AI sector, driving up stocks like Nvidia ($NVDA).

items.headline: U.S. Commerce Dept. Invests in Georgia Timber Industry
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce announced an intention to award $7.4 million in disaster supplemental funding to Georgia's Resilient Growth Through Enabling Next Generation Agriculture (REGEN AG) coalition, aimed at advancing the local timber manufacturing industry and building resilient supply chains.
